5. Slowly extend legs to elevate the bar to just above the knees, then extend hips to stand erect
6. Keeping the back flat and knees slightly flexed, push hips backward and lower torso until it is parallel with the floor

## Procedure

1. Maintain a torso position parallel to the floor, squeeze shoulder blades together, and flex elbows to pull them up and slightly outward
2. Pull the bar upward until it touches the upper abdomen (-37)
3. Return the bar to the start position in a slow, controlled manner
